title: Amnesty on Turkish media crackdown: 'Disinformation flourishes when media landscape's narrowed down'
summary: The state takeover of Halk TV, one of Turkey’s most widely watched news channels, represents far more than an isolated confrontation between the authorities and an independent broadcaster.
